javascript:(function(){if(!location.hostname.includes('people.zup.com.br')){location.href='https://people.zup.com.br/career/logbook';return;}const h=document.getElementById('zup-logbook-host');if(h){h.remove();}const s=document.createElement('script');s.src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/felipeaufe/zup-logbook@bookmarklet-simplified/dist/zup-logbook.bookmarklet.js?t='+Date.now();s.onerror=function(){alert('Erro ao carregar o script do Bookmarklet da CDN.');};document.body.appendChild(s);})();
